rows.commentary: 5.1: Razaullah digs it in short at the body, Ben Duckett swivels to pull from the crease, and while Rauf backtracks frantically in vain at long leg, the top-edge sails just over the rope for six.
5.2: Razaullah offers width on a length, and Ben Duckett seizes the opportunity by slashing it forcefully up and over the cover-point fielder to race away for four.
5.3: Razaullah attacks from round the wicket with a full angle, forcing Ben Duckett to prod off the outer edge down toward third man for a single.
5.4: Razaullah bangs it back of a length, allowing Jordan Cox to ride the extra bounce and dead-bat it toward backward point.
5.5: Razaullah pushes the speed up to 143.1 kilometers per hour on a length, shaping away sharply as Jordan Cox lifts his bat to watch it pass.
5.6: Razaullah targets off stump on a hard length, and Jordan Cox defends awkwardly off the splice straight to backward point.
6.1: Shaheen Afridi extracts unexpected extra bounce that startles Ben Duckett on the back foot, forcing a defensive chip that lobs harmlessly into the off-side turf.
6.2: Shaheen Afridi clocks 131.7 kilometers per hour with a fullish delivery around off, which Ben Duckett leans forward to nudge toward mid-on.
6.3: Shaheen Afridi stays on a length at 131 kilometers per hour close to off, and Ben Duckett plays a soft-handed block into the off-side.
6.4: Shaheen Afridi drifts slightly fuller near off at 132 kilometers per hour, prompting Ben Duckett to turn it off the inner half toward mid-on.
6.5: Shaheen Afridi strays onto the pads after four dots, and Ben Duckett relieves the pressure by exquisitely glancing it square across the leg-side boundary for four.
6.6: Shaheen Afridi digs it short into the pitch, but Duckett stands tall with supreme authority to pull it ferociously in front of square for back-to-back boundaries.
7.1: Haris Rauf digs this back-of-a-length delivery in, and Jordan Cox tucks his frame behind the line to dead-bat it back to the bowler.
7.2: Rauf strikes that three-quarter length once more, allowing Cox to absorb the lift and cushion it gently toward backward point.
7.3: Clocked at 138.8 kph on a length around off, Cox presents an open face to steer the ball directly to backward point.
7.4: Rauf serves it full on the stumps, and Cox leans into a drive past the bowler that races down the ground to open his account in style.
17.2: Razaullah digs this far too short over Sam Curran, forcing the leaping wicketkeeper to acrobatically pluck the wide delivery out of the air.
17.2: Razaullah offers a fuller length angled across, and Sam Curran drives it solidly straight to mid-off.
17.3: Razaullah bangs it in short and angling in, where Sam Curran mistimes his pull off the cue-end directly onto his pads.
17.4: Razaullah bowls a probing length that Sam Curran gently dabs towards the fielder stationed at cover.
17.5: Razaullah serves up a fuller delivery outside off, and Sam Curran punches it through to deep cover for a comfortable single.
17.6: Razaullah caps off the over with a shortish delivery angled in, pulled firmly to mid-on as the batters decline the run.
18.1: Salman Agha floats one up to Sam Curran, who presents the full face of the bat to push it down to long-off for a single.
18.2: Salman Agha keeps it tight as Ben Duckett attempts a late cut and is comprehensively beaten by the close line.
18.3: Salman Agha drifts this one in on an angle, allowing Ben Duckett to softly nudge it toward midwicket.
18.4: Salman Agha fires in a flatter delivery outside off, which Ben Duckett slaps away towards deep cover to claim a single.
18.5: Salman Agha darts it in quickly as Sam Curran steps back to punch towards cover, where a diving fielder cuts it off to his left.
18.6: Salman Agha finishes the sequence as Sam Curran utilizes the depth of his crease to pull smartly down to long-on for a single.
19.1: Shadab Khan loops it up into Sam Curran, who retreats and dead-bats it safely down the pitch.
19.2: Shadab Khan targets the stumps with inward turn, tucked away toward the mid-wicket fielder.
19.3: Shadab Khan drops it on the sticks with dip and turn, clipped firmly back as the bowler flings himself left to intercept.
19.4: Shadab Khan fires in the googly, nudged past short fine leg before a fumble in the outfield grants the second run.
19.5: Shadab Khan pushes it through, and Sam Curran drops back to milk a single out toward long-on.
19.6: Shadab Khan drifts one in slower on the stumps, and Ben Duckett unfurls a clever reverse-sweep, guiding the ball away to deep backward square leg to notch up a vital fifty-run partnership.
20.1: Salman Agha delivers to Ben Duckett, who knocks it down to long-off for a brisk single.
31.1: Haris Rauf targets the stumps, and Ben Duckett works the angle down to deep backward square for a comfortable single.
31.2: Will Jacks miscues a short delivery off the cue-end, lobbing it over mid-on where a desperate chase saves the boundary and allows three runs.
31.3: Haris Rauf pushes it up on a length, and Ben Duckett gets squarely behind the line to dead-bat it back to the bowler.
31.4: Haris Rauf loses control over his line, pitching it wildly outside off and well over Ben Duckett for a wide.
31.4: Ben Duckett punches a back-of-a-length delivery off the back foot, finding the cover fielder who dives sharply to his right.
31.5: Haris Rauf drifts onto the pads with a fuller delivery, and Ben Duckett clips it cleanly to deep midwicket for one.
31.6: Will Jacks pushes firmly down on a length ball, finding the fielder stationed at point.
32.1: Arafat Minhas finds slight dip without turn as Ben Duckett pushes forward, taking the outer half of the bat for a single.
32.2: Arafat Minhas attacks the stumps, prompting Will Jacks to nudge the ball straight back to the bowler.
32.3: Arafat Minhas loops one up, and Will Jacks stays in his crease to pat it wide of the bowler for a single.
32.4: Arafat Minhas drops it short, and Ben Duckett hangs back to tuck it safely toward the bowler.
32.5: Arafat Minhas tosses it up with some inward turn, and Ben Duckett pushes it straight back down the pitch.
32.6: Arafat Minhas loops it up, and Ben Duckett executes a clever reverse sweep down to deep cover for a single to crawl to ninety-seven.
33.1: Razaullah comes round the wicket with a leg-lined length delivery, tucked securely to backward square leg as Ben Duckett moves to ninety-eight.

33.2: Razaullah strikes at 138.5kph as Will Jacks closes his bat-face early on an angling length ball, offering a leading edge that the bowler brilliantly snaffles low to his left for a maiden ODI wicket.
33.3: Razaullah pounds in another testing delivery that Liam Dawson safely negotiates for a dot.
33.4: Razaullah serves it up to Liam Dawson, who promptly clips it away into the mid-wicket region for a single.
33.5: Razaullah digs it in toward the body, and Ben Duckett nudges it down to backward square leg for a single.
44.1: Shaheen Afridi comes round the wicket hurling it full and darted in, knocked firmly to the bowler's right as H Crocombe scampers the single past the scrambling Afridi.
44.2: Shaheen Afridi steams in at 128.8kph delivering full, prompting an uppish, untimed drive from Gus Atkinson that long-on mops up as the pair hustle two.
44.3: Shaheen Afridi floats an 115.7kph off-speed length delivery that Gus Atkinson stays leg-side of to effortlessly chip downtown over the rope, leaving long-on stranded as the ball sails past.
44.4: Shaheen Afridi angles a full delivery into the pads, neatly clipped to the right of long-on by Gus Atkinson for a brisk couple.
44.5: Shaheen Afridi bowls an 115.6kph slower ball that Gus Atkinson cushions with soft hands into the midwicket pocket for a single.
44.6: Shaheen Afridi tests H Crocombe with a sharp bouncer to finish the over, forcing the batsman to duck beneath it.
45.1: Shadab Khan tosses up a very full delivery outside off, drilled toward sweeper cover's right by Gus Atkinson to hustle back for two runs.
45.2: Shadab Khan slides an 86.6kph full ball down leg, tucked by Gus Atkinson to short fine leg before being rightly sent back on a single.
45.3: Shadab Khan drifts another delivery down the leg side, smoothly glanced by Gus Atkinson straight to short fine leg.
45.4: Shadab Khan drops an 89.2kph delivery on a length around off, solidly pushed into the off side defensively by Gus Atkinson.
45.5: Shadab Khan serves an 81.1kph full ball on off, met by Gus Atkinson lunging forward to bring his bottom hand into play and clip it through midwicket for one.
45.6: Shadab Khan fires an 88.9kph googly that H Crocombe reads off the pitch to hurriedly whip toward midwicket, drawing a smile from the bowler.
46.1: Shaheen Afridi targets the boots, forcing Gus Atkinson to shimmy down and toe-end a hurried drive back towards the bowler.
46.2: Shaheen Afridi drops the 134.8kph yorker on target, allowing Gus Atkinson to clear his leg and squeeze a single out to long-off.
46.3: Shaheen Afridi pulls his length back to 134kph, catching H Crocombe's toe-edge as the batter slices a cut toward cover.
46.4: Shaheen Afridi delivers a short-of-length ball that H Crocombe miscues to mid-off, where Babar Azam completes a sharp two-handed catch to seal England's 241-run all-out collapse.
5.1: H Crocombe drifts down leg with a fuller ball, conceding a wide as Babar Azam fails to connect.
5.1: H Crocombe serves a full delivery outside off that Babar Azam sweetly drives past mid-off for four.
5.2: H Crocombe angles one onto the pads, comfortably tucked toward midwicket by Babar Azam.
5.3: H Crocombe targets the body with a shortish delivery, safely pushed toward the on-side.
5.4: H Crocombe oversteps with a defensive delivery near the body, offering a free hit.
5.4: H Crocombe digs it in too short, sailing overhead for a wide.
5.4: H Crocombe tests the channel at 139kph, inducing a cue-ended push to mid-off.
5.5: H Crocombe floats one full outside off, allowing Babar Azam to squeeze a single past cover.
5.6: H Crocombe claims his maiden ODI wicket as Saim Ayub edges a tight delivery straight to Jamie Overton at slip.
6.1: Gus Atkinson fires a full ball into middle and off, safely patted back toward mid-on.
6.2: Gus Atkinson clocks 137kph in the channel, chopped down toward point by Babar Azam.
6.3: Gus Atkinson spears this length delivery into the channel, forcing Babar Azam to push it solidly right back down the pitch.
6.4: Gus Atkinson pitches this fuller and Babar Azam punches it on the up past mid-on, sending the ball racing away to the boundary.
6.5: Gus Atkinson produces a devastating seamer that sneaks through the gate, shattering Babar Azam's stumps and sending the batsman packing for 10.
6.6: No run for Salman Agha off Gus Atkinson.
16.1: Sam Curran delivers a 126.1ks short ball angling in, catching Salman Agha early on the shoulder as the ball trickles right of Cox while Nawaz's call for a single is promptly rejected.
16.2: Sam Curran keeps it short at 126.6ks, eluding Salman Agha entirely as the ball stays lower than anticipated and sneaks beneath his bat.
16.3: Sam Curran digs it in at 125.7ks, and Salman Agha stays on top of the bounce to steer it toward cover.
16.4: Sam Curran delivers at 128.1ks outside off, allowing Agha to angle the face and glide it down to third man.
16.5: Sam Curran targets the channel near off stump, and Hasan Nawaz gets behind the line to block it into the covers.
16.6: Sam Curran rolls out a 117.2ks slower ball outside off, which Nawaz guides cleanly square on the off-side.
17.1: Jamie Overton bangs in a 141.3ks hard length that rears with extra bounce, zipping right over the outside edge of Hasan Nawaz as he attempts a steer to third man.
17.2: Jamie Overton hits a 140.5ks back of a length on off, met by Hasan Nawaz who gets firmly behind the line to dead-bat it to cover.
17.3: Jamie Overton tests him with a 136.3ks delivery outside off, dabbed away fine to third man by Nawaz.
17.4: Jamie Overton hurries Agha with a 142.9ks body-line bumper that clips the glove into the vacant short leg pocket for a scampered single.
17.5: Jamie Overton fires it in at 140.6ks as Nawaz throws the kitchen sink at a wild leg-side heave, whistling past the outside edge.
17.6: Jamie Overton offers a fuller length on off, punched smoothly to mid-on by Nawaz as they sprint across.
18.1: Sam Curran loops it up on off and Hasan Nawaz digs the drive down to long-on for a single.
18.2: Sam Curran delivers a 127ks good length ball on leg, catching Salman Agha's leading edge as he plays leg-side, rolling away to sweeper cover for one.
18.3: Sam Curran lands it on a 127.6ks length around off, where Hasan Nawaz plays with soft hands wide of cover to rotate the strike.
18.4: Sam Curran digs into a 127.2ks short of length, pulled by Salman Agha straight to the fielder in front of square for a single.

18.5: Sam Curran angles a short ball in from round the wicket that Hasan Nawaz attempts to ramp while arching back, and after a failed caught-behind review with UltraEdge showing a flat line, England lose their challenge.
18.6: Sam Curran aims for the stumps, and Hasan Nawaz sits back to block it solidly into the off-side.
19.1: Jamie Overton charges in with a 137.3ks back of a length delivery, knocked toward cover by Salman Agha before abandoning a risky single.
19.2: Jamie Overton bangs it short at 140kph, and Salman Agha wisely aborts his plan to pull outside off into the onside.
29.4: Jamie Overton tests Shadab Khan with extra bounce, forcing a top-edged pull that Gus Atkinson almost intercepts after a full-length dive from deep backward square leg.
29.5: Jamie Overton delivers back of a length, and Shaheen Afridi clears his front leg to heave it past the deep fielder for a bouncing boundary at midwicket.
29.6: Jamie Overton caps a brilliant spell by inducing a wild swing from Shaheen Afridi, drawing an edge that Sam Curran safely claims at third man to seal figures of 3/43.
30.1: Liam Dawson tosses one full on leg stump, allowing Shadab Khan to knock it down to long-on for a single.
30.2: Liam Dawson extracts grip from a fullish length, catching Razaullah's outside edge as he pushes forward, sending the ball dribbling to short third man.
30.3: Liam Dawson angles his delivery towards off stump, and Razaullah gets forward comfortably to block it.
30.4: Liam Dawson slows it down on a length, letting Razaullah play with soft hands into the off-side.
30.5: Liam Dawson fires a quicker ball full around off, which Razaullah solidly blocks towards the cover region.
30.6: Liam Dawson slides one full and straying down the leg side, leaving Razaullah completely unbothered as it sails past.
30.6: Liam Dawson darts it in at a brisk pace, catching Razaullah's inside edge onto his pads as the batter lunges to drive.
31.1: Gus Atkinson pitches it up, allowing Shadab Khan to dance down the track and lift the ball cleanly over mid-off for four.
31.2: Gus Atkinson shortens his delivery, but Shadab Khan reads it early to pull ferociously through midwicket for consecutive boundaries.
31.3: Gus Atkinson offers width, and Shadab Khan times a crisp drive past sweeper cover to collect two comfortably.
31.4: Pacing in at 136.7kph, Gus Atkinson angles it in towards off and Shadab Khan works it smoothly into the midwicket region for a single.
31.5: Clearing his front leg to launch a heavy blow, Razaullah miscues the 135.5kph delivery straight out to midwicket.
31.6: Uncorking a brutal swing of the willow against a 139.8kph length ball, Razaullah deposits it high over deep midwicket to open his ODI account with a maximum.
32.1: No run for Shadab Khan off Liam Dawson.
42.2: Will Jacks floats one up on a length outside off, drawing the sweep from Shadab Khan who misses entirely and absorbs the blow on his shoulder from the sharp turn and bounce.
42.3: Will Jacks darts a slow off-spinner on a length, which Shadab Khan neatly chops away toward backward point.
42.4: Will Jacks tosses this one slightly fuller, and Shadab Khan calmly advances his front foot to block it out.
42.5: Will Jacks sends down a delivery that Shadab Khan moves back and across for, working it gracefully with the spin into the midwicket pocket for a single.
42.6: Will Jacks attacks with a leg-lined ball that is too full, allowing Haris Rauf to step forward and clip it out to deep square leg.
43.1: Sam Curran comes from round the wicket with a slower ball on a back of a length, forcing Shadab Khan to hop and chop it toward extra cover.
43.2: Sam Curran switches over the wicket, angling an inducing line across the right-hander that skids off the deck as Shadab Khan miscues his cut toward backward point.
43.3: Sam Curran pitches short of a good length just outside off, inviting Shadab Khan to punch it firmly toward deep cover.
43.4: Sam Curran offers a harmless back of a length delivery that sits up, allowing Shadab Khan to pull fiercely through midwicket for a one-bounce four and reach his highest ODI score of 90.
43.5: Sam Curran serves up a low full toss outside off, which Shadab Khan drives straight to mid-off.
43.6: Sam Curran delivers a length ball on the stumps that Shadab Khan pushes toward mid-on, scampering across for a single to a deafening roar from the Lahore crowd.
44.1: Gus Atkinson starts a fresh spell with a fullish ball angling in, but Shadab Khan brilliantly gets low to sweep it high and handsome over fine leg for six, racing to 97.

44.2: Gus Atkinson spears in a full toss that catches Shadab Khan plumb on the ankle, sparking an immediate appeal and an initial finger-raise from Rashid Riaz, only for a dramatic review to expose a tiny spike on UltraEdge and rescue the Pakistan all-rounder.
44.5: Gus Atkinson spears a searing yorker into the stumps, allowing Shadab Khan to force it down to mid-on and rotate the strike.
44.6: Gus Atkinson tests the full length, inducing Haris Rauf to stroke a drive straight to the fielder stationed at mid-off.
45.1: Sam Curran takes pace off with a testing delivery on a length, nudged cleanly into the off-side by Shadab Khan.
45.2: Sam Curran unleashes a clever slower-ball off-cutter that beats Shadab Khan all ends up as the batsman flashes too early.
45.3: Sam Curran targets the pads with a skidding delivery, drawing an optimistic appeal before it deflects off Shadab Khan's gear toward short fine leg.
45.4: Sam Curran floats a full delivery that is punched toward mid-off for a sharp single, capped by Jordan Cox's sprawling dive at the stumps.
45.5: Sam Curran finds the full face of the bat as Haris Rauf drills it through the covers, though a slip turning for the second run leaves him in visible discomfort.
45.6: Sam Curran fires in a sharp bouncer that sails over Shadab Khan, sparking a fiery verbal exchange that draws swift intervention from the officials.
46.1: Gus Atkinson delivers a full ball on the stumps that is instantly stabbed away, only for the fielder to miss a frantic shy at the non-striker's end.
46.2: Gus Atkinson slides a yorker wide where Shadab Khan squeezes it past a fumbling fielder to seal a magnificent, landmark international century.
46.3: Gus Atkinson misses his yorker length entirely, serving up a juicy low full toss that Shadab Khan effortlessly dispatches square through the leg-side.
46.4: Gus Atkinson nails a searing near-yorker that is hurriedly blocked into the leg side, aborting a risky single as the throw flashes back in.
46.5: Gus Atkinson offers a full toss outside off and Shadab Khan steers it gently into the off-side.
46.6: Gus Atkinson misses his yorker length and Shadab Khan brutally punishes the slot ball, launching it cleanly over long-off for a massive maximum.
47.1: H Crocombe fires an overpitched delivery that Haris Rauf fiercely drills past the bowler's outstretched hand and away to the boundary to seal a historic Pakistan victory.
